questions.prompt: Unlike a woodcut or an engraving, traditional lithography prints from what kind of surface?

choices.text: A mesh with a stencil attached
A plate with ink held in incised grooves
A carved block with raised printing areas
A flat surface using oil-and-water repulsion

questions.hint: The design need not be raised or cut below the printing surface.
questions.explanation: Lithography is planographic: greasy image areas attract ink while damp non-image areas repel it.
